name: San Miguel de Abona (Spain)
description: A blue hoist third and a yellow fly.
history: The municipal flag was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands by order of 23 February 1998 as a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its width, composed of two vertical stripes, the blue one at the hoist of a third of the cloth and the yellow one at the fly of the remaining two thirds; if the flag bears the arms they are placed at the centre of the yellow stripe. The municipality also has a square cadmium-yellow standard approved by order of 22 September 1997.
